web.cabinet.cardLives: The card stays in the feed for 4 hours 20 minutes, the discount until {until}.
web.cabinet.codeSpent: After several wrong tries the code is voided and a new envelope is needed.
web.cabinet.codeWrong: The code didn’t match. Tries left: {n}. After several wrong tries the code is voided and a new envelope is needed.
web.cabinet.duplicate: Same text as a live offer. You already have an offer with this text. Change the text or wait until the old one expires.
web.cabinet.envelopeSent: an envelope with the code is on its way to {address}; the code lives 30 days
web.cabinet.limit: Requests per address are limited. The email comes to the same address.
web.cabinet.linkOnce: The link works once and lives 15 minutes; it opens in the same browser where you asked for it.
web.cabinet.linkOnceSpent: The link works once and lives 15 minutes; it goes out on first use. It opens in the same browser where you asked for it.
web.cabinet.linkOnly: Sign-in only by the link from the email.
web.cabinet.moveWarn: A new point removes the confirmation: a new envelope is needed.
web.cabinet.name: name
web.cabinet.noEdit: A published offer can’t be edited.
web.cabinet.noVenue: Until the point is confirmed, an offer can’t be published.
web.cabinet.notUsNote: The venue is suspended at once; the owner’s other points keep working. Only a new envelope with a code sent to the venue’s address lifts it.
web.cabinet.notUsTitle: Didn’t ask for an envelope or add this point?
web.cabinet.placeNone: no point set — offers can’t be published
web.cabinet.pointNumbers: A point is latitude and longitude as numbers.
web.cabinet.publishNote: The offer goes out at once and in full. A published offer can’t be edited: not the text, the discount or the terms.
web.cabinet.publishedNote: The offer goes out at once and in full, link included, with no pre-moderation.
web.cabinet.sent: if the address is registered, the email is on its way
web.cabinet.title: Ad cabinet
web.cabinet.tooMany: Too many requests. Try again in {n} s.
web.cabinet.unverifiedNote: Until the point is confirmed, an offer can’t be published. Each venue has its own envelope.
web.cabinet.within90: no later than 90 days after publishing
web.card.block_warning: The author will vanish from your feed, and you from theirs. Shared matches and conversations will end. You can undo it in “blocked”.
web.card.complained: Complaint sent. The decision will come by email.
web.card.liked: Like sent. If you like each other, it’s a match.
web.card.matched: A match! An offer to talk is waiting in your inbox.
web.chat.extra_they: your conversation partner liked another of your messages
web.chat.extra_you: you liked another of your partner's messages
web.chat.endAsk: The conversation ends for both of you, and it can’t be brought back.
web.chat.keys_not_kept: The node didn’t keep the keys of this conversation ({reason}): after a page reload it won’t open — ask for new keys then.
web.chat.over_text: The keys are wiped on both sides. Nothing can read this any more — for anyone.
web.chat.peer_moved: The other side changed device and asks for new keys. Earlier messages won’t come back.
web.chat.rekey_asked: request for new keys sent (epoch {epoch}), waiting for consent
web.chat.rekey_waiting: Request for new keys sent — waiting for the other side to agree.
web.chat.update: the node speaks another protocol version — reload the page
web.composer.hint: It goes from your point into the circle you chose. A clean phrase goes out at once; a doubtful one is read by a person first.
web.composer.linked: the same point and step will link your phrases together
web.composer.placeholder: who’s up for the waterfront at nine?
web.feed.blocked: Author blocked: their phrases are gone from here.
web.feed.empty_hint: No one in your circle is talking right now.
web.feed.hidden: The phrase is hidden from your feed.
web.feed.keys_new_wrap: unlocked with the PIN, the wrap is NOT the same
web.feed.keys_unlocked: unlocked with the PIN, the wrap is the same
web.feed.sent_held: Your phrase is being read — it goes out after the check:
web.feed.title: Feed
web.game.rematch_offered: The other side offers another round
web.game.title: Game
web.inbox.empty_hint: Like someone’s phrase, get a like back — and an offer to talk shows up here.
web.inbox.span: goes out after {n} min of your silence
web.inbox.title: Talks
web.likes.empty_hint: Liked phrases gather here while they live.
web.likes.spent: this like already made a match — it can’t be taken back
web.likes.title: Liked
web.likes.unlike_failed: Couldn’t remove the like. Try again.
web.match.agreed: They already agreed and are waiting for you.
web.match.hint: Talk — and once both agree, the conversation opens. Its keys are born with the two of you; the node doesn’t see them.
web.match.queue_hint: You can write: lines stay on this device and go out once you both agree.
web.newTable.name: name — optional
web.newTable.title: New table
web.offer.checkCode: Check the code in the address: we never had a link with this code, or it’s gone.
web.offer.disabled: The link is off: the offer was taken down, hidden after complaints, or the discount ran out. It leads nowhere now.
web.offer.leadsTo: The link leads to the site
web.offer.title: Offer link
web.offer.authorLink: This is the offer author’s link.
web.offer.wrong: The link leads to the wrong place
web.offer.warn: We don’t check what’s there today: look at the domain, not the promise. A visit is counted once.
web.register.confirm: Written it down? Enter the second and fourth groups.
web.register.consent: I accept the terms of use, the privacy policy and the community rules
web.register.easy_pin: this PIN is easy to guess
web.register.groups_mismatch: the groups don’t match the code — check what you wrote down

web.reissue.enterGroups: Written it down? Enter the second and fourth groups.
web.reissue.mismatch: the groups don’t match the code — check what you wrote down
web.reissue.writeDown: Write this code down on paper. It’s the only way to get your identity back: we have no email or password, we can’t remind you of the code, and it won’t be shown again. The old code stops working as soon as the new one is confirmed.
web.table.con_agree: agreed: the round goes to the opponent
web.unlock.forget: this isn’t me — forget this device
web.unlock.remembers: This device remembers you. Enter your PIN to go on.
web.unlock.restore: open the device with the paper code
web.vault.pinLocked: ten wrong PINs: sign-in closed until the paper code
web.chat.blocked: You blocked this person. The conversation is closed for both, the keys are wiped.
web.chat.missed: you missed a message — ask them to send it again
web.feed.refused: Your phrase did not pass moderation and was taken down.
web.theme.title: Theme
web.theme.auto: auto — day and night of the place
web.card.heart: heart: drag onto the phrase, or tap it, then the phrase
web.card.heart_wait: the like goes in {n} s — you can take it off
web.filter.title: Age filter
web.filter.hint: by the year, inside your band
web.legal.title: Documents
web.legal.accept_terms: I accept the terms of use
